description: This source file defines the NonPeriodic class which provides functions for financial calculations related to cash flows, including IRR and NPV for non-periodic cash flows.

classes.name: NonPeriodic
classes.description: A class providing methods for calculating internal rate of return (XIRR) and net present value (XNPV) for non-periodic cash flows.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Calculates the internal rate of return for a schedule of non-periodic cash flows using iterative root-finding methods.

methods.name: presentValue
methods.description: Calculates the net present value for a series of non-periodic cash flows at a given discount rate.
